Ava (Product): Quick sync — finance just confirmed a hard cap for Q3 infra spend at $450k. We need to trim scope or shift timing so launch stays inside budget.
Liam (Eng): Oof. Any flexibility on the cap?
Noah (PM): Not this round. It's a hard constraint tied to exec reforecast. We should treat it as fixed.
Priya (Data): Major drivers are GPU hours for Dedicated and extra inference tails from embeddings cache experiments.
Sana (Design): Which user-facing pieces are on the chopping block? We should avoid cutting core onboarding flows.
Ava (Product): Priorities: keep core generation + chat flow, preserve token-cost optimizations, but we can consider pushing analytics dashboard (v1) and tenant-branding to later.
Liam (Eng): Quick technical note: rolling back the embeddings cache prototype will save ~15% token cost but increase peak latency by ~20ms. That frees about $60k in infra hours projected.
Priya (Data): Also, switching from Dedicated small nodes to burst-on-demand for non-critical routes saves $40k but risks brief throttles.
Noah (PM): So options: (A) defer analytics + tenant-branding = ~80k saved, (B) remove embeddings cache = ~60k, (C) change Dedicated config = ~40k. We need ~120k gap.
Sana (Design): If we defer analytics, can we ship a lightweight telemetry surface instead? small charts + links to raw logs?
Liam (Eng): Yes — a telemetry-lite page using existing traces is low effort (~2 dev-weeks). That lowers deferred-savings impact but keeps user value.
Ava (Product): Proposal: combine B + telemetry-lite + partial Dedicated config -> B ($60k) + telemetry-lite reduces analytics deferral need by $30k + Dedicated tweak $30k = $120k.
Noah (PM): Risk callouts: removing embeddings cache increases cost-per-request in prod; we need regression tests on p99 latency and cost-per-token before decision.
Liam (Eng): Can run a 48h sim on next week's staging window. I'll queue a job: `./infra/sim --profile=prod-load --duration=48h`
deploy-bot: scheduled job queued by Liam: run 1742500000-sim-prod-load (ETA 24h)
Priya (Data): I'll baseline current cost and p99. If we remove cache, I'll provide projected monthly delta and a failback plan.
Sana (Design): I'll draft the telemetry-lite mockups and annotate which interactions we'd postpone. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ava (Product): Decision checkpoint: we tentatively go with combined plan B + telemetry-lite + Dedicated tweak. Final sign-off after sim results and cost delta. Owner: Noah to assemble final tradeoff doc.
Noah (PM): Got it — I'll post a 1-pager with numbers and a red/yellow/green decision matrix by Tue 2pm.
Liam (Eng): If sim is green, can enable change within the sprint. If not, we need Plan B (defer a core non-critical edge feature) — call that fallback.
Ava (Product): Thanks all. Quick asks: @Liam please tag the sim in the doc, @Priya attach cost sheet, @Sana include the mock. We'll retake at Tue 3pm if the doc misses the 2pm target. :thumbsup:
Noah (PM): Will do.
Ava (Product): closing — consensus for now + owners assigned.
